This post mixes a custom JSX island component with a code demo whose
highlighted template used to leak a bare expression, tripping the
bundler's downstream-parser gate and degrading the whole page to the
raw-body render shape.

<Note title="Design token lint demo">

  A demo whose highlighted template used to leak a bare expression:
<pre><code>{\d}</code></pre>

  A JSX comment that must survive verbatim: {/* design-token-lint-ignore */}

</Note>

Prose after the island — if the page had degraded to the raw-body render
shape, this island and this sentence would both be replaced by a raw
block instead of rendering as real content.
